title: The GitHub MCP Server
description: A remote tool server that advertises each GitHub operation as its own named tool, with the credential referenced from an environment variable.

steps.description: This is the GitHub MCP server, a tool server. It advertises each operation as its own named tool, so the agent calls `github_create_issue` rather than composing a command line, and a tool name has one spelling your rules can match.
The server is named `github`. `type` is `remote` and `url` is the hosted endpoint `https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/`, with `oauth` set to false.

`headers` carries the credential as `"Authorization": "Bearer {env:GITHUB_SCRATCH_PAT}"`. That is the name of a variable, not its value. The page says to give the agent a token scoped to one repository, never your personal one.

steps.question: The page says the hosted server is an HTTPS endpoint, so it works anywhere the network does, including where?
